articles.title: Rochdale Council Transitions to TrendAI Security System
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Council has successfully transitioned from Microsoft security to TrendAI in just six weeks, enhancing its cybersecurity measures. This change aims to improve data protection and response capabilities.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Council has completed a transition from Microsoft security systems to TrendAI in six weeks. This change aims to bolster cybersecurity measures and enhance data protection for its operations.

The decision to switch to TrendAI was made to improve the council's response capabilities to potential cyber threats, ensuring sensitive information remains secure.

The implementation of TrendAI is expected to provide better tools for monitoring and responding to security incidents, thereby reducing the risk of data breaches.

Further updates on the effectiveness of this new system will be shared in due course.

articles.title: Planning Application Submitted for Nine Houses at Little Nook Farm, Middleton
articles.excerpt: SM Properties has applied to Rochdale Council to replace Little Nook Farm with nine detached homes, following the demolition of existing structures.
articles.content_html:
SM Properties has submitted a planning application to Rochdale Council to demolish Little Nook Farm, located on Heywood Old Road in Middleton, and replace it with nine detached houses. The proposal includes the construction of seven homes along the Heywood Old Road border and two additional homes towards the back of the site.

The site currently comprises a farmhouse and several outbuildings, with the first records of the farm dating back to 1848. The farmhouse itself was extended between 1968 and 1970. Planning documents indicate that the existing structures will be removed to facilitate the new development.

According to Groves Town Planning Ltd, the proposed homes will feature three, four, and five bedrooms, catering to a range of family sizes. The application aims to enhance the local housing stock while making efficient use of the land.

The next steps in the planning process will involve a review by the council, which will consider the application and any public comments before making a decision. Residents and stakeholders may wish to monitor the progress of this application as it could impact the local community.

articles.title: Rochdale Valiant Launches New Media Portal for Community Engagement
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Valiant has introduced a new media portal aimed at enhancing local news and information access for residents.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Valiant has launched a new media portal designed to provide the community with up-to-date news and information. This initiative aims to enhance public engagement through published media, reflecting a commitment to serving local residents.

The portal, accessible at www.rochdalevaliant.uk, features a variety of articles and resources intended to inform residents about local developments and issues.

The launch of this portal signifies an effort to strengthen community ties by offering relevant content and a platform for residents to voice their concerns and opinions.

Rochdale Valiant's new media portal is positioned as a key resource for residents, aiming to keep them informed and involved in local matters.
